title: Draft Night Cheat Sheet
lede: Duskmourn and Crimson Vow, mixed. Search any card, or switch sets when the packs change.
deck_note: is fine for a low-curve W/R deck

sets.name: Duskmourn

booster.name: Play Booster
facts: 7 commons, 3 uncommons, 1 rare or mythic, 1 land, 2 wildcards of any rarity (one is foil).
The land slot is often a common dual land. Raucous Carnival is the W/R one.

keywords: Rooms
An enchantment with two doors. Cast one door now; pay to unlock the other later.
Eerie
Triggers when an enchantment enters under your control or you fully unlock a Room.
Manifest dread
Look at your top 2 cards: one becomes a face-down 2/2 creature, the other goes to your graveyard. If the face-down card is a creature, you can flip it up any time for its mana cost.
Delirium
A bonus once your graveyard holds 4+ card types (creature, land, instant, enchantment…).
Survival
A bonus at the start of your second main phase if the creature is tapped, usually because it attacked.
Impending
Cast an Overlord cheaply. It enters with time counters and isn't a creature until the last one comes off (one per end step), but its "enters" ability fires right away.

sets.name: Crimson Vow

booster.name: Draft Booster
facts: 10 commons, 3 uncommons, 1 rare or mythic, 1 basic land.
At least 2 cards are double-faced. Read both sides.
About 1 pack in 3 swaps a common for a foil of any rarity.

keywords: Blood token
Pay 1, tap, discard a card and sacrifice it: draw a card.
Disturb
From your graveyard, cast the back side for the disturb cost. If it would die again, it's exiled.
Training
Gets a +1/+1 counter when it attacks alongside a creature with greater power.
Exploit
When it enters, you may sacrifice a creature. If you do, you get the card's bonus.
Day / Night
Starts once a day/night card appears. Night falls after a turn where the active player cast no spells; a turn with 2+ spells brings back day.
Decayed
Can't block, and is sacrificed at end of combat after it attacks.
Cleave
Pay the higher cleave cost to delete the words in [brackets], which removes a limit on the spell.
